text: Some do, but it's harder than it was for our parents, because prices for flats and cars have risen much faster than salaries. Many young people save for something specific, like a phone or a trip, rather than for the long term. Online shopping and instalment plans make it very easy to spend, so saving really requires discipline nowadays.

tips.en: Prices … have risen much faster than salaries is an argument based on facts.
tips.kk: Prices … have risen much faster than salaries — деректі дәлел.
tips.ru: Prices … have risen much faster than salaries — аргумент с фактами.
tips.example: prices for flats and cars have risen much faster than salaries

tips.en: Something specific … rather than for the long term is a precise observation.
tips.kk: Something specific … rather than for the long term — дәл байқау.
tips.ru: Something specific … rather than for the long term — точное наблюдение.
tips.example: rather than for the long term

text: Yes, I think it's one of the most practical things a school could teach. Many people leave school knowing complex formulas but not how interest on a loan works or how to plan a monthly budget. It wouldn't need to be a whole subject — a few lessons a year with real examples, like comparing two phone contracts, would already help a lot.

tips.en: Complex formulas but not how interest … works is a vivid argument.
tips.kk: Complex formulas but not how interest … works — жарқын дәлел.
tips.ru: Complex formulas but not how interest … works — яркий аргумент.
tips.example: knowing complex formulas but not how interest on a loan works

text: It depends on what the thing is. Taking a mortgage for a flat is often the only realistic option, and it can be a sensible decision. But borrowing for a new phone or a holiday is usually a mistake, because you end up paying much more than the real price. Borrowing from friends is even riskier in a way, since you can lose both the money and the friendship.

tips.en: A flat … But a new phone … gives different answers for different purchases.
tips.kk: A flat … But a new phone … — әртүрлі сатып алу, әртүрлі жауап.
tips.ru: A flat … But a new phone … — разные покупки, разный ответ.
tips.example: Taking a mortgage for a flat is often the only realistic option

tips.en: Lose both the money and the friendship is a memorable ending.

tips.ru: Lose both the money and the friendship — запоминающаяся концовка.

text: In big cities it's already almost gone — I can't remember the last time I paid for coffee with notes. But I don't think it will disappear everywhere. Older people and some villages still rely on it, and cash works when the internet or the bank's system is down. I'd actually be worried about a world with no cash at all, because every purchase would leave a record.

tips.en: I can't remember the last time … is evidence from everyday life.
tips.kk: I can't remember the last time … — өмірден дәлел.
tips.ru: I can't remember the last time … — доказательство из жизни.
tips.example: I can't remember the last time I paid for coffee with notes

tips.en: Every purchase would leave a record is an argument about privacy.

tips.ru: Every purchase would leave a record — аргумент о приватности.

text: Up to a point, definitely. If you can't pay your rent or buy medicine, money makes a huge difference to your happiness. But once your basic needs are covered, extra money seems to matter much less than health, relationships or interesting work. Some of the richest people I've read about sound quite lonely, which suggests money can buy comfort but not everything else.

tips.en: Up to a point is a precise position rather than just yes or no.
tips.kk: Up to a point — «иә» не «жоқ» емес, дәл ұстаным.
tips.ru: Up to a point — точная позиция, а не «да» или «нет».

tips.en: Money can buy comfort but not everything else sums it up in one sentence.
